definitions.explanation: Describes something that is a perfect circle or sphere. An emphatic form of {丸|まる}い, stressing the completeness of the roundness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真|ま}ん{丸|まる}だ。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}ん{丸|まる}な⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧。
examples.english: The baby's perfectly round eyes are cute.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}めて→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧{真|ま}ん{丸|まる}になっている。
examples.english: The cat has curled up into a perfect ball.

notes:
{真|ま}ん{丸|まる} is an emphatic form of ⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧, describing something that is perfectly circular or spherical with no irregularity. The {真|ま}ん～ prefix intensifies the meaning, similar to {真|まっ}{白|しろ} (pure white) or {真|まっ}{赤|か} (bright red).

FORMS:
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}な + noun — modifier form
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}い — adjective form (i-adjective variant)
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}だ — predicate form

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}な⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ — perfectly round eyes
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}な⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ — a perfectly round moon
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to become a perfect ball/circle
